tidasa.p: [Ti+dasa] (na) CL=7 Thirty, (Transcendental virtue etc.,) which involves thirty kinds. Tidasa(ti) [ti+dasa. Tīṇi dasa parimāṇametesanti tidasā, devā. Samāsantassa attaṃ. Idha parimāṇa-saddassa sannidhānato dasa-saddo saṅkhyāne vattate. Rū. 352.(-moga, 3. 17). Tvatīyāyovanākhyādagāsadāyepāma. Byākhyāsudhā-ṭī. Ti+ti+dasa. Dasa ca dasa ca dasa ca dasa, tīhi adhikā dasa tidasa. Titidasāti vattabbeti-saddalopotipivadanti. Ma, ṭī, 1. 31. Ti+dasā. Jāti-sattāvināsasaṅkhātā tisso dasā avatthā etesanti tidasā. Aṭṭhasā, yo. 2. (B) Tāvatiṃsā Deva (belonging to the (Heaven of the) thirty three).Tidasa tidasa(ti) [tidasa+ṇa] (A) Deva realm. See also - Tidasālaya-(A). (B) Tāvatiṃsā Deva realm. See also - Tidasa-(2).
pn: Tidasa. A name given to Tāvatiṁsa, the inhabitants being called Tidasā (Ja.iii.357, 413; vi.168; v.20, 390). The Tidasa Devas are spoken of as being full of glory. SN.i.234.

Tidasa，（num．） [Vedic tridaśa] thirty （cp．tiṁsa），esp．the thirty deities （pl．） or belonging to them （adj．）．It is the round figure for 33，and is used as equivalent to tāvatiṁsa．Nandanaṁ rammaṁ tidasānaṁ mahāvanaṁ Pv III，119=Vv 1813； devā tidasā sahindakā Vv 301； Sdhp．420．

--âdhipati the Lord of the 30 （viz．Sakka） Vv 478； --inda ruler of the 30 Sdhp．411，478； --gaṇa the company of the 30 Sn．679 （Com．tettiṁsa）； Vv 416； --gatin going to the 30 （as one of the gatis） Vv 3512 （=tidasabhavanaṁ gata Tāvatiṁsadevanikāyaṁ uppanna VvA．164）； --pura the city of the 30，i．e．Heaven Miln．291； --bhavana the state of the 30，i．e．heavenly existence VvA．164 （=Tāvatiṁsabhavana）．（Page 302）

tidaṇḍa.p: [Ti+daṇḍa=daṇḍaka] (pu,na) CL=7 [Kaccaññaḥ. 325. Rū. Rū, ṭī. 295, 4 =349. Moga. Pañcikā, 2. 18. Nīti, sutta. 598, 703. (tridaṇḍa=tridaṇḍaka-saṃ)]. (1) Tidaṇḍa (Tripod) which is include in articles for use by Hermit, (A) A tripod (three legs chair) on which to put jug. See also - Tidaṇḍaparidhāraka. (B) The stick which base part and topmost part have triple rod. (C) The base of the stick has triple rod (Tripod) which is chair for putting and offering open oil lamp.(D) Walking stick which is made of bamboo which is also Tripod. See - Tidaṇḍī. (2) Triple rods or poles. (3) Three rod or stick which are supported and leaned each and other. (4) Thong for tying the yoke to the shaft of a bullock cart, Three sticks are attached and tied A set of bullock cart body (such shaft wheel body frame etc.,) on the shaft of the yoke of the bullock cart. (5) Stand for a monk's bowl which is made with three rods. (6) The chair which has three legs on which to put conch shell (cup). (7) The forked prop placed under the yoke of a bullock cart which has tripod at base. (8)  Three kinds of Ajjhattadaṇ which are Kāya (physical body), Vacī (Verbal), Mana (mental faculty)).  See - Tidaṇḍī-(2).  (9) Paribbaja (homeless spiritual seeker) who was named Tidaṇḍa. (10) It is like the stick which is forked prop placed under the yoke of a bullock cart and  the base of that stick has Tripod. See - Vesārajjatidaṇḍaka.

tidiva.p: [Ti+deva] (pu,na) CL=7 [Tayo devā dibbantyatreti tidivo. Padhānato hi tīhi hariharabrahmehi byapadeso. Dhāna, ṭī. 10. Ti+diva. Tidivāti manussacātumahārājikaloke upādāya tatiyalokabhūtā devaṭṭhānā, nāmameva vā etaṃ tassadevaṭṭhānassa. Anuṭī, 3. 111.(kridiva-saṃ)] (1) Deva realm, (A) Tāvatiṃsā Deva realm. See also - Tidivapuravara. (B) Tusitā Deva realm. (C) Catumahārāja Deva realm. See - Tidivādhāra. (2) Brahma realm. (3) The sky (or) Heaven. See - Tidivaṅgaṇa. Tidiva(ti) [tidiva+ṇa] It is being in Deva realm, (A) Wealth (peace and delight) of Deva. (B) Tāvatiṃsā Devas. တာဝတိံသာဟူသော မြို့တော်ရှိသော နတ်၊ တာဝတိံသာနတ်။ တိဒိဝပုရဝရ-ကြည့်။

B:
tidivapura： tidivapura（ti）
တိဒိဝပုရ（တိ）
[tidiva（1）+pura]
[တိဒိဝ（၁）+ပုရ]
K:
tidivapura：တိဒိဝပုရ（တိ）
[တိဒိဝ（၁）+ပုရ]
တာဝတိံသာဟူသော မြို့တော်ရှိသော နတ်၊ တာဝတိံသာနတ်။ တိဒိဝပုရဝရ-ကြည့်။

tidivapuravarasama.p: [Tidivapuravara+sama] (ti) CL=7 One who is like Sakka. See - Tidivapuravara.
a: တိဒိဝပုရဝရသမ(တိ)
[တိဒိဝပုရဝရ+သမ]
သိကြားမင်းနှင့်တူသော၊ သူ။ တိဒိဝပုရဝရ-ကြည့်။

B:
tidivapuravarasama： tidivapuravarasama（ti）
တိဒိဝပုရဝရသမ（တိ）
[tidivapuravara+sama]
[တိဒိဝပုရဝရ+သမ]
K:
tidivapuravarasama：တိဒိဝပုရဝရသမ（တိ）
[တိဒိဝပုရဝရ+သမ]
သိကြားမင်းနှင့်တူသော၊ သူ။ တိဒိဝပုရဝရ-ကြည့်။

tidivābhibhū.p: [Tidiva+abhibhū] (pu) CL=7 One who rules over Deva realm, Sakka.
a: တိဒိဝါဘိဘူ(ပု)

B:
tidivābhibhū： tidivābhibhū（pu）
တိဒိဝါဘိဘူ（ပု）
[tidiva+abhibhū]
[တိဒိဝ+အဘိဘူ]
K:
tidivābhibhū：တိဒိဝါဘိဘူ（ပု）
[တိဒိဝ+အဘိဘူ]
နတ်ပြည်ကို လွှမ်းမိုးအုပ်ချုပ်သူ၊ သိကြားမင်း။

tidivūpapanna.p: [Tidiva+upapanna] (ti) CL=7 One who reaches to Tāvatiṃsā Deva realm.
a: တိဒိဝူပပန္န(တိ)

B:
tidivūpapanna： tidivūpapanna（ti）
တိဒိဝူပပန္န（တိ）
[tidiva+upapanna]
[တိဒိဝ+ဥပပန္န]
K:
tidivūpapanna：တိဒိဝူပပန္န（တိ）
[တိဒိဝ+ဥပပန္န]
တာဝတိံသာနတ်ပြည်-၌ဖြစ်-သို့ရောက်-သော၊ သူ။
R:
tidivūpapanna：တိဒိဝူပပန္န （တိ） （တိဒိဝ+ဥပပန္န）
တာဝတိံသာနတ်ပြည်သို့ ရောက်သည်။
